svg.text: A node of a chained program (an effect: its input and its output) as one block with one header, to save room on the face.
Two frames in one outline: the name twice, two bands, two IN/OUT tags.
The name once, across a band half the input's colour, half the output's; IN and OUT at the band's ends.
B · ONE BAND, IN AND OUT BELOW
The name once on a plain band (IN ▸ OUT at its right); IN and OUT printed over each half.
Input jack at the left edge, output at the right, an arrow between; small meters; one SPLIT for both.
